about_short_description.short_description: Loula is a developer of payment platform designed to help businesses in providing employees easy access to their earned money.

product.name: Loula Digital Wallet
product.description: A digital wallet providing users with a U.S. dollar account to receive payments, convert currencies, and transfer funds between U.S. and Argentine accounts.

product.name: Salary Advance Service
product.description: A service allowing users to request an advance on their earned salary through the Loula platform as a short-term loan.

product.name: Currency Conversion and Transfers
product.description: A platform feature that facilitates currency exchange between USD, USDC, and ARS, and enables transfers across banking systems, countries, and wallets.

product.name: Loula Business Program
product.description: A program for companies offering financial benefits, reduced transaction fees, and access to sector analysis and collaborative workspace.
